title.value: Learning Invariances via Neural Network Pruning

TLDR.value: We use small initializations and contrastive learning to introduce invariance-preserving inductive biases via network pruning.

abstract.value: Invariance describes transformations that do not alter data's underlying semantics. Neural networks that preserve natural invariance capture good inductive biases and achieve superior performance. Hence, modern networks are handcrafted around well-known invariances (ex. translations). We propose a framework to learn novel network architectures that capture data-dependent invariances via pruning. Our learned architectures consistently outperform dense neural networks on both vision and tabular datasets in both efficiency and effectiveness. We demonstrate our framework on several neural networks across 3 vision and 40 tabular datasets.

primary_area.value: unsupervised, self-supervised, semi-supervised, and supervised representation learning
